capabilities.description: Prefetch upcoming TV episodes when Silo playback sessions change.
Administrator status and read-only connection checks.

global_config_schema.title: Prefetch settings
global_config_schema.description: Silo session access, two Sonarr instances, and prefetch filters.

fields.label: Enable prefetch
fields.description: Turn on after saving settings and testing connections.

fields.label: Silo admin API key
fields.description: An administrator API key permitted to read active sessions.

fields.label: Sonarr URL
fields.description: Standard Sonarr base URL, e.g. http://sonarr:8989. Include a reverse proxy base path if used.

fields.label: Sonarr API key
fields.description: Sonarr Settings > General > Security > API Key.

fields.label: 4K Sonarr URL (optional)
fields.description: A second Sonarr instance. Both instances prefetch when they contain the series.

fields.label: 4K Sonarr API key (optional)
fields.description: Required when the second Sonarr URL is set.

fields.label: Episodes ahead
fields.description: Next N episodes after the playing episode, including episodes with files already present in Sonarr. Continues into the next season; skips specials.

fields.label: Minimum playback progress (%)
fields.description: Wait until the current episode reaches this percentage before monitoring or searching upcoming episodes. Default 10 waits until 10% progress. 0 triggers immediately. Resuming or seeking past the threshold qualifies; unknown duration waits when this is above 0.

fields.label: Include users / profiles
fields.description: Optional account IDs, usernames, profile IDs, or profile names. Commas or newlines. Empty allows all. Names match without case sensitivity.

fields.label: Exclude users / profiles
fields.description: Account or profile IDs/names to skip. Exclusions override inclusions.

fields.label: Include Sonarr tags
fields.description: Optional tag labels; a series must have at least one. Evaluated separately in each Sonarr. Empty allows all series.

fields.label: Exclude Sonarr tags
fields.description: Series with any matching tag label are skipped. Exclusions override inclusions.

presentation.summary: Request Sonarr searches for upcoming TV episodes as you watch in Silo.
presentation.description_markdown: Receives Silo session-change events and reads active episodes through Silo's v2 admin sessions API. By default, waits until playback reaches 10% before monitoring missing episodes in the next configured window and requesting searches for those that have aired. The threshold is configurable; 0 starts immediately. Checks one or two Sonarr instances wherever the series exists. Supports account/profile inclusion and exclusion, and Sonarr tag filters. Series must already exist in Sonarr. Queued episodes and recent searches are skipped. Sonarr handles release selection and its configured download clients. Discovers its own Silo server automatically and sends requests only to that server and your configured Sonarr endpoints; no telemetry. API keys travel in headers; redirects are refused. Status and connection checks require a Silo administrator.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Enter a Silo API key owned by an administrator with scopes left empty (unrestricted). Silo has no restricted scope for the required sessions endpoint; its URL is discovered automatically.
2. Enter the standard Sonarr URL and API key; optionally add 4K Sonarr.
3. Choose episodes ahead, minimum playback progress (default 10%), and user/tag filters. Save.
4. Open Prefetch status and test connections.
5. Enable prefetch, save, and play a TV episode until it reaches the configured progress threshold. Review status and Sonarr Activity.
